revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~2.4% was depressed by FX/refranchising; mature staple with pricing plus modest volume, fading to 3.5%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941) vs 21.2% FY2024 and 24.7% FY2023; FY2025 likely includes non-recurring items, so 27% is a haircut to FY2025 and above the 3-yr average.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: below 21% US statutory given foreign mix; Damodaran industry effective rate 6.8% considered too low for sustained use.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.669 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) unlevered cash-corrected 0.575, D/E 0.206, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 7.84% cost of equity; pretax cost of debt 5.29% (Damodaran) -> 4.18% after tax; weights 82.9%/17.1% (Damodaran industry; no share price available) -> ~7.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements KO derived net_debt = total debt 45,436 (LT debt 42,119 + current 1,822 + commercial paper 1,495) - cash 10,270 - ST investments 3,602; accession 0001628280-26-010047
